name: Quali-Smart Holdings Limited
summary: Quali-Smart Holdings Limited is an investment holding firm that has been based in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong since 2012. It has two lines of business, making and distributing toys and providing financial services such as securities brokerage, underwriting, margin financing, advisory and fund management. It also trades and invests in securities and funds. Its operations reach Hong Kong, North America, Europe, China, Taiwan, Central America, Australia and the Pacific.
